title: Uncle drummers and learning to play
summary: He first played drums at home with his uncles and was encouraged to learn clarinet; they discuss a relative who played clarinet and died young.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: Picking up the first horn: clarinet and saxophone beginnings

blocks.x: How did you get started on your first instrument?

First instrument, there had a lot of drums around the house. I had three uncles who played drums. Paul Bowman, Lloyd Bowman, and Lucien Bowman. They all played drums. So naturally I'd sit behind Lucien's drums. He'd always play with those 56th Ray Jazz bands, and they'd be mad at us. So I'd sit around and have intermissions, or if there was a low, I'd play the drums. So I'm going to keep the beat. Of course I got the beat. And then it was suggested I learned to play kindly, because we had a great clan that played in our band. And our family called Lloyd Arthur Dog, my mother's uncle. He died young after that. At the age of 21. He was a virtuoso according to George Fields and my grandfather and Manny Perez.
